description: Dated advertised retailer observations for one product plus min, max and median, and recorded 30 and 90 day lows. Numeric summaries require one known currency across eligible current and historical observations; missing or differing currencies produce null summaries with an explanation, without conversion. Coverage varies; these are not exact-variant verified purchase quotes. Every price carries observed_at and expires_at; do not quote after expires_at.
